description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management system. It generates a report that analyzes test plans with custom fields (CFs) that have the scope 'Test Plan Design SCOPE'. The script initializes the page, retrieves test plan details, linked custom fields, and their values, and displays the data in a formatted HTML table with customizable columns and sorting.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Represents an extendable HTML table with custom behaviors and grouping used for displaying test case data with custom fields.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Builds an external table displaying test cases with custom field values, organized by test suite, with sorting and toolbar options.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves arguments for test plan ID and related data from session or request parameters.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has the right to access test plan metrics within a project.
